messages.en:
{07 00 00}So I bought some furniture
at {ff 00 00 06}Redd{ff 00 00 00}'s the other day and
sold it at {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s...
{07 16 00}But for a fraction of the
cost that I paid for it!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Total rip-off!
{07 00 00}I mean, {ff 00 00 06}Redd{ff 00 00 00} carries some
pretty rare items...

{07 16 00}But {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00} has that
{ff 00 00 02}point system{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

Man, I'm stumped. {07 0b 00}Which one
do you think is the better
value, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma ostsin üleeile {ff 00 00 06}Reddi{ff 00 00 00}
juurest mööblit ja müüsin
selle {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nookile{ff 00 00 00}...
{07 16 00}Aga murdosa eest sellest,
mida ma maksin!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Täielik tüssamine!
{07 00 00}Ma mõtlen, {ff 00 00 06}Reddil{ff 00 00 00} on päris
haruldasi asju...

{07 16 00}Aga {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nookil{ff 00 00 00} on see
{ff 00 00 02}punktisüsteem{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

Mees, olen ummikus. {07 0b 00}Kumb
on sinu arust parem
valik, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So I bought a dresser at
{ff 00 00 06}Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s the other day and
jammed my clothes in it...
{07 14 00}Man, that thing could store
an elephant!{01 00 00 05 00} Dressers never
held this much before!
{06 01 00 03 04 05}

{07 0c 00}Oh, I forgot to tell ya!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 00 00}I heard this from someone
who went to another town...
{07 15 00}This dude said the shop had
stuff you can't find in
{04 03 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Man,{01 00 00 0f 00} who knew {ff 00 00 06}Nook{ff 00 00 00} was so
dang sly?
messages.et:
{07 0c 00}Oh, ma unustasin öelda!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 00 00}Ma kuulsin seda kelleltki,
kes käis teises linnas...
{07 15 00}See tüüp ütles, et poes oli
kraami, mida {04 03 00}s
ei leia, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Mees,{01 00 00 0f 00} kes teadis, et {ff 00 00 06}Nook{ff 00 00 00}
on nii pagana kaval?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}That means that I should
be able to add those last
few precious pieces...
{07 0a 00}Yeah! {01 00 00 05 00}My collection of
wrestling uniforms will soon
be complete, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See tähendab, et ma peaksin
saama lisada need viimased
väärtuslikud tükid...
{07 0a 00}Jaa! {01 00 00 05 00}Mu maadlusvormide
kogu saab varsti
valmis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Forget clothes! I might
start sleeping in my
dresser, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Unusta riided! Ma võin
hakata oma kummutis
magama, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
